meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按需编排镜头与动态元素,产出多场景视频、品牌宣传片或混剪成片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要做较长的多场景视频或宣传片,却没有现成的专用流程可用
copy.tagline_en: Compose scenes and motion to produce multi-scene videos, brand reels, or remixes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a longer multi-scene video but no specialized workflow fits

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能创作或修改 HyperFrames 自定义视频合成：多场景长片、品牌片、蒙太奇、静态循环、标题卡、素材混剪等。它会先做规划，写出项目与分镜文件，再构建。
howto.when: 当你没有合适的专用工作流、或 BRIEF.md 里设为 flow: companion 时接管。新创作会先经 hyperframes 路由，短的无旁白动态单元则导向 motion-graphics。

say.text: 用 general-video 做一个 30 秒品牌宣传片
say.note: 会先规划并生成分镜，再进入构建。

say.text: 把这段素材剪成一段多场景蒙太奇
say.note: 按剪辑顺序生成场景并排布片段。

say.text: 在 companion 模式下和我一起改第 3 个场景
say.note: 按 companion 流程逐项确认改动。

howto.what_en: Makes Claude author or edit a custom HyperFrames video composition: multi-scene pieces, brand reels, montages, static loops, title cards, footage remixes. It plans first, writes project and storyboard files, then builds.
howto.when_en: It takes over when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Fresh creation routes through hyperframes first; short unnarrated motion units go to motion-graphics.

say_en.text: Use general-video to make a 30-second brand reel
say_en.note: It plans first, then writes a storyboard.

say_en.text: Cut this footage into a multi-scene montage
say_en.note: It builds scenes and orders clips.
